metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 2021 · Black Widow
metas.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.3 · 2021 · Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2021 · Eternals
metas.description: The saga of the Eternals, a race of immortal beings who lived on Earth and shaped its history and civilizations.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 8.1 · 2021 · Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.8 · 2022 · Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.1 · 2022 · Thor: Love and Thunder
metas.description: Thor enlists the help of Valkyrie, Korg and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster to fight Gorr the God Butcher, who intends to make the gods extinct.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.6 · 2022 · Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
metas.description: The people of Wakanda fight to protect their home from intervening world powers as they mourn the death of King T'Challa.
